notes.title: Item Limit Change
notes.content:
Why?

Why is always the question. 

Why, oh why did I do it?

This question has been asked of me numerous times.

I may not have the answer, however I may now have the solution...

[b]Item limit increased from 9 to 20![/b]

Okay, I know it's not [i]that[/i] exciting and it isn't anything fantastic like say 99, but I hope it will afford some comfort for all you weary travelers with full pockets.

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
Updated corescript and plugins to improve performance and reduce occurrences of bugs.

If any bugs are found, please report them in the Vane discussion thread so that they may be squashed.

Thank you, awesome players!

notes.title: Super Bosses and More
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A mysterious new island has appeared where even greater challenges await those who desire fantastic treasures and continued conquest.

[*] Added more weapon choices for Kokkol to craft.

[*] Lowered the required enemy Gems needed to craft mid to late game Jewels.

[*] Enemies will no longer respawn when leaving the Mythril Mine to the Valley of Seasons and vice versa.

[*] Minor balance adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Jewels and Appearance Update
notes.content:
Save Menu UI Updated.

Added the Jewelcrafter.
-Combine Gems to make a Jewel which grants permanent abilities and attribute bonus.
-The Jewelcrafter may be found in every town.

Added more appearance options and the option to change mid-game.
-8 more options to chose from.

Added new discoverable locations to the world map.

Fixed a bug preventing the player from leaving King Ferim's Chambers.
